asks: How long would you give it?
description: A person sat with the particular stillness of someone who arrived early for something enormous and has been early ever since. The floor around them is worn in a small ring, and the ring is old.
emotes: {it} looks toward the door and then away again.
{it} rearranges the small pile beside it and puts it back as it was.
looks: There's a hollow worn where they sit, smooth, and it fits them exactly.
Their belongings are stacked beside them in the order they stopped needing them.
They look up when you come in, and the looking up is practised and immediate.
name: somebody who has waited here a long time
says: You aren't it either. That's all right.
I would have missed it if I had gone for food.
It has been longer than this before.
